The Domes of Demetrica are places of safe harbour where one can wait out the war. Near the edge of the region, far away from conflict they promise to keep the population secure. Billions of people went. You will find them inside.

Demetrica environment

> Weather

Demetrica can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, or Forsaken weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Bloody Appararus

Demetrica has a unique Bloody Apparatus that spawns on the exterior. It is in a room that is directly behind the ship when the door opens and it is on top of a platform that requires a jetpack, extension ladder, or the company cruiser (not recommended) to reach. Removing this apparatus triggers all apparatus related events.

Entering this room will trap the player inside and activate two walls with skulls on them. These walls move around the room in straight lines counter-clockwise and briefly stop to turn corners. To escape, there is a door on the other side of the room that has a panel to the right with multiple switches. Flicking a switch will also flick every adjacent switch and players must turn on all the switches, indicated by the switch being down and lit green, to open the door.

The walls remain active for the rest of the day. If a player escapes the room through the door, both sides of the room will open and the room will be accessible for the rest of the day. If no player escapes the room through the door after triggering the trap, it will remain inaccessible for the rest of the day.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Logging "Radio Message 4" found on the exterior of Filitrios.

Unlocks

Hyx: Acquire the Bloody Apparatus on the exterior of this moon and insert into its respective slot in the hidden area in Galetry. This also requires the Royal Apparatus from Calist and the Cosmic Apparatus from Cosmocos.
Alcatras: Log "Secret files" that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
